text: Displacement is the shortest straight-line distance between start and end?

options.text: True - displacement is the vector shortest path
False - displacement is total distance travelled

explanation: Displacement is the straight-line change in position; distance is total ground covered.

text: A metal spoon in hot soup heats up mainly by which process?
explanation: Metals conduct heat via colliding particles.

text: Which wave type vibrates perpendicular to energy travel?
explanation: Transverse vibrates across travel direction; sound is longitudinal.

text: Gases have no fixed shape or volume because their particles move freely?

options.text: True - they expand to fill the container

explanation: Gas particles move freely and fill available space.

text: Rusting of iron is which type of change?

options.text: Chemical - new substance iron oxide forms

explanation: Rusting creates iron oxide, a brand-new substance.

text: Ionic bonds form by what mechanism?

options.text: Electron transfer from one atom to another

explanation: Sharing gives covalent bonds; transfer gives ionic bonds.

text: Plant cells have a rigid cell wall for structure and protection?

options.text: False - only animal cells have walls

explanation: The wall supports plants; animal cells have none.

text: Which tissue carries food made in leaves to the rest of the plant?
explanation: Xylem carries water up; phloem carries food around.

text: Reflex actions are slow conscious decisions by the brain?
explanation: Reflexes are fast, automatic, often spinal.

text: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth?
explanation: 1 AU at light speed takes ~8 minutes.

text: Black holes have gravity so strong that not even light escapes?
explanation: The event horizon is the point of no return.

text: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
explanation: Mars looks red from rusty surface dust.

text: Earth's crust is divided into moving tectonic plates?

options.text: True - drift causes quakes and mountains

explanation: Plate tectonics explains earthquakes and ranges.

text: Igneous rocks form from which process?
explanation: Granite and basalt are cooled molten rock.
